name: Vanilla
source:
A mysterious girl who appears before the protagonist. Covered in white, she has pale skin, with white hair as well as a white dress. Her very existence is shrouded in mystery...

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2018/08/10/vanilla/]Official Site[/url]]
